name: DragonBrain
description: An intelligent, fair and cinematic Ender Dragon overhaul with a complete original End visual identity: five biome material sets, three new creatures (End Wisp, Rift Stalker, Ancient Sentinel), the Abyssal Cataclysm dragon, original textures, models, particles and sound design.

custom.dragonbrain:optional_resource_packs: See CREDITS.md — Beyonder - End Tweaks (MIT) and Fancy End (CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0) are independent third-party packs; install them from their authors. DragonBrain bundles no third-party textures.
